p2g3.body: There are 345 varieties of parrot in existence and, of these, [[24]] live in Australia. As early as the [[25]], the mapmaker [[26]] recognized that parrots lived in that part of the world. [[27]], the famous painter of animals and birds, commented on the size and beauty of the Australian parrot family.
